integrity: All computations are reproducible by the included standard-library Python verifier. Reported counts follow exhaustive finite enumeration and have no asymptotic or extrapolated interpretation.
scientific_limitations: An exact exhaustive finite classification only for the twenty-vertex graph GP(10,2). The prior scalar isoperimetric value and abstract Petersen antipodal quotient are known, not claimed as new. Unindexed earlier enumerations could overlap; there has been no independent audit.
title: First-excitation connectivity and Petersen bridges among dodecahedral bisections
